Bind topology=shared-daemon only in the independently admitted candidate document; do not invent qualifiedSurfaces or completed evidence digests. Events remain explicitly unattributed to a client surface. Completed HostQualification is a later decision after actual Desktop and CLI evidence.

reviewedLaterSequence.effect: After activation approval, bounded direct supported Unix-WebSocket /rpc attachment validates LOCAL_PEERPID + live exact engine CDHash and projects hooks/list digests only. It spawns no proxy or child, resumes no task, and closes the socket on exit. This does not qualify Desktop.

reviewedLaterSequence.action: initialize experimentalApi=true,requestAttestation=false,optOutNotificationMethods=every exact generated method except hook/started and hook/completed; fail on schema drift.
hooks/list for exact qualification cwd; persist only bounded metadata/digests, never command bodies or raw task identifiers.

reviewedLaterSequence.stdin: Exact independently confirmed existing active UUIDv7 plus newline; supplied in memory, never a command argument or persisted file.
reviewedLaterSequence.effect: Check bounded thread/loaded/list membership, call thread/resume only with threadId and excludeTurns=true, require exact ID/cwd/active status and no returned turns/history page, recheck loaded membership. Observe only typed hook events for <=30 seconds, then recheck membership/peer before emitting hashes. Socket closure detaches this client.
reviewedLaterSequence.raceLimit: No atomic already-running-only API exists. Resume can rehydrate an unloaded existing task if it races; no new task/turn is requested. Any observed unload/status mismatch invalidates and discards campaign; hidden races are not ruled out or promoted into authority.
reviewedLaterSequence.privacy: Resume response schema includes preview/paths/config metadata even with excludeTurns=true. Client discards these in memory and never emits/persists them; it issues no thread/read, turns/list, items/list, or history request.

rollback: Failure, abandonment or later teardown only: checkpoint and normal-quit the qualification app before stopping its owned daemon. A successful independent qualification handoff instead preserves the exact measured runtime.
Stop only the daemon created by this campaign after revalidating recorded process/socket ownership; do not stop a replacement or pre-existing daemon.
Use pinned codex app-server daemon stop; never bootstrap/uninstall or modify user config.
Relaunch /usr/bin/open -a /Applications/Codex.app without extra environment and verify original stdio mode.
openGates: Shared-daemon runtime verifier is implemented with reciprocal kernel socket handles, exact socket path, PID birth checks and per-surface evidence digests. Its local Unix-socket regression is not an actual Desktop connection witness or qualification campaign.
Loaded framework/JS bytes of the already-running app are not retrospectively proved by static validation plus main-image CDHash. Fresh verified launch and actual host observations are required.
No native AHI case, performance threshold, critical recall result or root admission is established by this proposal.
Non-query p95 remains <=250ms and query p95<=500ms; no relaxed threshold.
Both codex-desktop and codex-cli actual evidence are mandatory before shared-runtime FULL; Desktop-only evidence refuses admission.
